# Pip Files

> Pip Files is an experimental, original native Swift app for local macOS folder automation. It applies ordered rules to direct files inside selected folders, with a reviewable preview and explicit Apply step. Neutral Core and Pip Core share one engine.

This file is a factual map of the public project for people and language models. It makes no claim about search ranking, recommendation or endorsement.

## Project

- [Repository and source](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files): public MIT-licensed app source and build instructions.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): macOS requirements, source build, signature check and disposable first-run workflow.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): answers about scope, privacy, safety, Hazel workflow gaps and current platform verification.
- [Verification and acceptance](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md): source commit, test/build results, native evidence and open gates.
- [Workflow coverage](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/PARITY.md): implemented behavior and known gaps against the Hazel workflow reference.
- [Research and provenance](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/REFERENCES.md): source/licence checks and the role of referenced projects.
- [AI-assisted setup](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/AI-SETUP.md): a constrained setup prompt and exact local commands.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting guidance and privacy boundaries.
- [Release notes](https://github.com/Ghostzy0/pip-files/blob/main/docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md): current experimental Core scope and release limits.

## Current status

- The public source includes a generic partial-workflow Neutral Core and a Pip-themed Core. Neutral Core is not a faithful Hazel recreation. The Plus feature set is not in this public source and has not been released.
- The source has no third-party Swift package, model, cloud service or hosted font dependency. Core operations are local.
- GitHub Actions tests and builds on macOS 14. Recorded native workflow acceptance is limited to macOS 27.0.1 arm64 at an earlier source commit; the current edition-isolation packages still need native reacceptance.
- No downloadable binary release is currently published. Local app bundles are ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarised.
- Hazel is a proprietary workflow reference. Pip Files is not affiliated with Noodlesoft and does not claim complete Hazel parity.
